name: Deluge
primary:
A wall of water rolls across the aimed spot, sweeps everyone there away and puts out any fire.
The wave travels 9 blocks through that spot, away from you, and widens to 9 blocks. Where it passes, real water floods the ground and drains after 3 s.
Everyone the wave catches takes:
• Damage 4 ❤ water
• Soaked for 20 s
• Swept away and lifted
• Puts out fire within 12 blocks: burning blocks and every creature there
self_description:
On you:
• Soaked for 15 s and leaves a puddle
• Puts out fire within 12 blocks: burning blocks and every creature, you included
• Slow falling for 15 s
